To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the replication and maintenance of pSU316 are controlled by two different regions of the molecule, that the replication region is located in the 2-kilobase (kb) EcoRI-BamHI fragment, and that the region controlling plasmid stability is located in the EcoRI-PstI fragment.

the hemolytic IncFIII-InFIV plasmid pS316 contains two determinants involved in plasmid replication and maintenance: a replication region that includes an origin of replication and an IncFIII inactivation determinant.
we have identified and located several genes involved in control of pSU 316 replication and stable maintenance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the molecular mechanisms involved in the control and regulation of the replication and the stable maintenance of the IncF plasmids.
the study of the genetic determinants of the replication and stable plamid maintenance of the hemolytis plasmid pSu316.
the cloning of the IncFIV determinant from pSU316, and with the identification of the IncFII determinant of this hemolytic plsmid.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
pSU3027 contains at least four genes (repFIIIA, repFIIIB, parFIIIA and parFIIIB) involved in plasmid replication and maintenance.
the IncFIII determinant is a 3.2 kb DNA fragment located at 3.8 map units on pSU316.
the IncFIII determinant is located between 0.5 and 2.5 kb on the right side of pSU316, and that it includes the genes for plasmid replication, partition and incompatibility.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

pSU3027 contains a region which codes for the maintenance of the IncFIV plasmid, and a region which codes, in the presence of a functional IncFIV determinant, for the replication and maintenance of the IncFI plasmid.

(1) the IncFIII determinant is located in a region of 3.3 kb, which includes a putative parA-like gene, (2) a region of 0.8 kb located downstream of the IncFIV determinant is required for pSU316 replication, and (3) a 1.2-kb region located between the IncFIII and the replication determinants, contains a gene involved in the stable maintenance of pSU316.

the pSU306 Tn802 insertion has inactivated an IncFIII replication function, and that the pSU316 IncFIV determinant is located in a region which is not involved in pSU306 replication, maintenance, and hemolytic activity.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the IncFIII determinant is encoded by a 3.3-kb PstI fragment located at the right end of pSU3025 and that the IncFIV determinant is encoded by an 0.8-kb EcoRI fragment located at the left end of the plasmid.
the pSU3027 and pSU3025 plasmids are useful for the genetic analysis of the replication and stable maintenance of the IncF plasmids.
pSU316 is a complex plasmid with a number of genes involved in plasmid replication and stability.
